entities.text: High Court Of Punjab & Haryana At Chandigarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner was granted interim bail with direction to join investigation with the police vide detailed order dated 15.3.2024.

While passing the said order, Coordinate Bench observed as follows : -
iT9
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that all the payments have been made by cheque and that the panchayat had passed resolution pertaining to the expenditure concerned.

It has further been submitted that recovery of amount in question had also been ordered to be effected from the petitioner pursuant to the proceedings conducted under provisions of Section 53(2) of Haryana Panchayati Raj Act PARITOSH KUMAR . eae 2024.07.12 18:40 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act')
and that upon the petitioner | attest to the accuracy and authenticity of this Judicial Jitender Kumar vs State Of Haryana on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182660912/
1 Record/Decree/Document PARITOSH KUMAR 2024.07.12 15:40 | attest to the accuracy and authenticity of this Judicial Record/Decree/Document 2024; PHRC OBB74 CRM-M-13360-2024 (O&M) having challenged the same in an appeal before the Deputy Commissioner under provisions of Section 53(3) of the Act, status quo had been ordered to be maintained as regards the recovery proceedings and thus the question as regards the embezzlement is yet to be finally adjudicated in appeal and that, under these circumstances, when the department itself is considering the said matter, the FIR in question is an abuse of process of law."
3.

entities.text: Haryana Panchayati Raj Act PARITOSH KUMAR
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioner submits that by virtue of the aforesaid interim order, the petitioner has already joined investigation with the police.

4. State counsel on instructions from SI Bajinder submits that indeed, the petitioner has joined investigation with the police and accordingly, the present petition be disposed of with direction to the petitioner to join further investigation as and when asked to do so.

In view of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is allowed and order of interim bail dated 15.3.2024 is hereby made absolute subject to the conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
The petitioner should join further investigation as and when asked to do so by the police.
